title: Starlink: undisclosed maneuvers are the biggest LEO risk
subtitle: 11k+ sats publishing hourly ephemeris, ~650 third-party encounters, and 164,000 near-misses after surprise moves.

as_of: Grounded in Jim's Interest Journal research and content notes for Tue Oct 6, 2026. Figures are SpaceX/Starlink-reported via TeslaNorth coverage.
